mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) indicate accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals labor market slack that triggers central bank policy easing, reducing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 460) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 11350) indicates demand contraction that prompts aggressive monetary stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 460 and GDPC1 < 11350 (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising) signal inflation control efforts that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline (INDPRO < 97.0) signals manufacturing contraction that triggers central bank stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0 (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 460) and residential finance activity (RSAFS < 340000) indicates housing market contraction that prompts monetary stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 460 and RSAFS < 340000 (over 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Supply shock regime (INDPRO < 96.0) signals industrial output contraction that increases input costs and inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 96.0 (over 5-year rolling window).
